entities.name: Bifunctional IspD/IspF
observations: 389-aa query has 65.7% identity and 96.9% query coverage to reviewed Ruegeria pomeroyi IspD/IspF (Q5LRN5), E=2.81e-161; annotation is homology-based.
Pfam matches IspD (PF01128; residues 9–217) and YgbB (PF02542; residues 233–386).
Predicted activities: MEP cytidylyltransferase (EC 2.7.7.60) and ME-cPP synthase (EC 4.6.1.12); reference annotation reports a divalent-metal cofactor.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: Reference homologs annotate participation in the methylerythritol phosphate pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate and terpenoid biosynthesis; query assignment is by strong homology.
